scenarios.name: InfraLLM-01 LLM client resolves base_url from environment variable

steps.text: environment variable SCENARIO_FORGE_MODEL_BASE_URL is set to http://test:8080
an LLMClient is constructed without explicit base_url
the client base_url is http://test:8080

scenarios.name: InfraLLM-02 LLM client resolves model name from environment variable

steps.text: environment variable SCENARIO_FORGE_MODEL_NAME is set to test-model
an LLMClient is constructed with base_url http://test:8080
the client model is test-model

scenarios.name: InfraLLM-03 LLM client explicit args override environment variables

steps.text: environment variable SCENARIO_FORGE_MODEL_BASE_URL is set to http://env:8080
an LLMClient is constructed with base_url http://explicit:8080 and model explicit-model
the client base_url is http://explicit:8080
the client model is explicit-model

scenarios.name: InfraLLM-04 LLM client without base_url raises ValueError

steps.text: no SCENARIO_FORGE_MODEL_BASE_URL environment variable is set
an LLMClient is constructed without explicit base_url
a ValueError is raised containing No LLM endpoint configured

scenarios.name: InfraLLM-05 LLM client auto-injects OpenRouter headers

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
the client extra headers include HTTP-Referer and X-Title

scenarios.name: InfraLLM-06 LLM client default temperature is 0.4

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url http://test:8080
the client temperature is 0.4

scenarios.name: InfraLLM-07 LLMResult carries content and usage telemetry

steps.text: an LLMResult with content text, prompt_tokens 100, completion_tokens 50, and duration_ms 5000
the result content is text
the result prompt_tokens is 100
the result completion_tokens is 50
the result duration_ms is 5000

scenarios.name: InfraCallLog-01 call log entry written as JSONL

steps.text: a call log entry with stage stage_2, step call_1, slot_id RESP-1:CA-1-1:NOT_PROVIDED, and scenario_id null
the entry is appended to calls.jsonl
the file contains one valid JSON line with stage stage_2 and step call_1

scenarios.name: InfraCallLog-02 call log entry with scenario_id set

steps.text: a call log entry with stage stage_6_narrative, step call_a, slot_id null, and scenario_id SCN-001
the entry is appended to calls.jsonl
the file contains one valid JSON line with scenario_id SCN-001

scenarios.name: InfraCallLog-03 multiple call log entries appended sequentially

steps.text: three call log entries with stages stage_2, stage_3, and stage_5
all entries are appended to calls.jsonl
the file contains three valid JSON lines in order

scenarios.name: InfraCallLog-04 empty entry list does not create file

steps.text: an empty list of call log entries
the entries are appended to calls.jsonl
no calls.jsonl file is created

scenarios.name: InfraYAML-01 write_yaml serializes Pydantic model to YAML file

steps.text: a LossAnalysis model with one loss L-1 and one hazard H-1
write_yaml is called with the model and a file path
a YAML file exists at the path containing loss_id L-1

scenarios.name: InfraYAML-02 read_yaml loads YAML file into Pydantic model

steps.text: a YAML file containing a valid loss analysis with loss L-1
read_yaml is called with the path and LossAnalysis class
a LossAnalysis model is returned with loss_id L-1

scenarios.name: InfraYAML-03 YAML round-trip preserves model data

steps.text: a ControlStructure model with responsibility RESP-1 and PM-1-1
the model is written to YAML and read back
the read-back model matches the original model

scenarios.name: InfraYAML-04 read_yaml on invalid data raises validation error

steps.text: a YAML file containing a loss analysis where hazard references non-existent loss
read_yaml is called with the path and LossAnalysis class
a validation error is raised

scenarios.name: InfraTemplates-01 template loader accepts a custom prompts directory

steps.text: a prompts directory at tmp/prompts containing template test.j2 with variable name
a template loader is created with the directory path
render_prompt is called with template test.j2 and name World
the rendered text contains World

scenarios.name: InfraTemplates-02 hash_prompt_templates returns SHA-256 hashes

steps.text: a prompts directory at tmp/prompts containing templates a.j2 and b.j2
hash_prompt_templates is called with the directory path
a dict is returned with keys a.j2 and b.j2 mapping to 64-character hex digests

scenarios.name: InfraTemplates-03 undefined template variable raises StrictUndefined error

steps.text: a prompts directory containing template test.j2 with variable name
render_prompt is called with template test.j2 without providing name
an undefined variable error is raised

scenarios.name: InfraTemplates-04 template loader is independent of existing pipeline prompts

steps.text: a template loader created with directory tmp/stpa_prompts
the loader does not reference the existing pipeline data/prompts directory

scenarios.name: InfraManifest-01 valid run manifest passes validation

steps.text: a run manifest with run_id RUN-001, run_dir output/test, and created_at 2026-08-08T12:00:00Z
the manifest is validated
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: InfraManifest-02 manifest with fill_rate and counts passes

steps.text: a run manifest with slot_count 10, na_count 2, fill_rate 0.8, and scenario_count 5
the manifest is validated
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: InfraManifest-03 manifest with critic findings passes

steps.text: a run manifest with critic_findings gap in hazard coverage, missing constraint for H-2
the manifest is validated
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: InfraManifest-04 manifest with eval scorecard path passes

steps.text: a run manifest with eval_scorecard_path output/test/eval-scorecard.yaml
the manifest is validated
validation succeeds

scenarios.name: InfraManifest-05 manifest is not coupled to existing v3 sentinel system

steps.text: the STPA run manifest module is imported
the module does not import or reference the existing pipeline manifest module

background.text: the STPA infra module is importable
